title: Returning traveler duty-free exemption
facts: Many returning U.S. residents can qualify for a personal duty exemption on a limited value of merchandise acquired abroad, but the amount depends on destination, length of absence and other rules.
A commonly applicable exemption is up to $800 for qualifying returning residents after an absence of at least 48 hours, subject to frequency and merchandise restrictions.
Alcohol, tobacco and goods from particular destinations can have special quantitative or eligibility limits.
Travelers should verify the current CBP exemption that applies to their itinerary rather than assuming every trip receives an $800 exemption.
